chunks: Whosoever desires what hastes away, We hasten to give him (in this life) as much as We please to whosoever We will; but afterwards there is Hell for him in which he will burn, disgraced and ostracised.

key_terms.الْعَاجِلَةَ: The fleeting worldly life or immediate pleasures

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Ajilah' in the Quran and what is the fate of those who desire it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transient nature of worldly gains granted to the heedless, contrasting them with the eternal reward of the faithful. It underscores the concept of 'Istidraj' (gradual facilitation) where God grants desires to those who seek only the material world, leading to their ultimate disgrace in Hell. The verse serves as a warning against prioritizing immediate gratification over spiritual permanence.
